description: This file defines the Graph class for manipulating directed acyclic graphs (DAGs), including methods for constructing, searching, sorting, and analyzing graph components.

classes.name: Graph
classes.description: A class representing a directed acyclic graph (DAG) with methods for construction, depth-first search, and sorting.

methods.name: searchAndSort
methods.description: Performs a depth-first search and sorts the DAG, computing paths, reverse paths, weights, and components.

methods.name: depthFirstSearch
methods.description: Recursively performs depth-first search on the graph, assigning components, and recording paths and reverse paths.
